name: Obezglavlennaja
source:
In the 19th century, there was one small town. There was a cute and pretty girl in that town. The old town's folks liked her for her kindness and courtesy.

Men were following her in crowds, trying to gain her favor. There were even married men among them too. But she did not reciprocate them, for her heart already belonged to another. The one who did not answer her feelings in kind and even did not recognize them. Though he himself was interested in her, she, because of her timidity, did not notice it, supposing that she was fooling herself.

Her loved one did not give her attention, and the others who called her on a date wanted only one thing. Out of despair, she has decided to take an extreme step. It was in the late evening. Dark streets, illuminated only by a faint light from the windows of the houses, became deserted, filled with silence, sometimes interrupted by the dog barking and slight coughing of a gentleman standing at the door of her house...

She sat down in front of the mirror, took the scissors and...

The dark history of the small town begins.
translation:
19世纪，有一座小镇。镇上住着一个可爱漂亮的姑娘，镇里的老人都喜欢她的善良与彬彬有礼。

男人们成群结队地追随着她，试图博取她的欢心，其中甚至有已婚之人。然而，她从未回应，因为她早已心有所属。她喜欢的人既不回应这份感情，甚至连察觉都没有。其实，他也对她有意，只是她生性羞怯，未能留意，还以为一切都是自己的痴心妄想。

心上人不曾关心她，其他约她出去的人却都只想要一件事。绝望之下，她决定采取极端的行动。那是一个深夜。黑暗的街道空无一人，只有屋内透出的微光照亮四周。一片寂静中，偶尔传来狗吠，以及站在她家门前的一位绅士轻轻的咳嗽声……

她在镜子前坐下，拿起剪刀，然后……

小镇的黑暗往事，就此拉开序幕。
